settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.body: Ships worldwide within 48 hours; most destinations arrive in 3 to 7 business days, tracked by email. Thirty-day returns, no interrogation.

settings.heading: Clinical evidence
settings.body: Silicone sheeting has been used on scars since 1983 and is listed as a first-line, non-invasive option in international scar-management guidelines. Proof improves the appearance of scars, texture, color and relief. We don't claim more than that.
